description: This file defines a configuration class for Amazon's Bedrock 'Converse' API, including methods for request transformation, content parsing, tool handling, and response processing tailored specifically for Bedrock's API features and constraints. It also handles environment validation, error reporting, and stream behavior adjustments, making it integral for interfacing with Bedrock's conversational models.

classes.name: AmazonConverseConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interfacing with Amazon Bedrock's Converse conversational API, providing methods for request preparation, response parsing, tool management, environment validation, and streaming control tailored specifically for Bedrock models.

methods.description: Converts consecutive user messages at the end of the message list to guarded_text format if guardrailConfig is present and such messages don't already have guarded_text.
